Rule: Use a strict 32x32 grid for all tiles (terrain, walls, props).
Rationale: RPG Maker XP maps, passability and autotile seams assume a consistent 32px grid; breaking it causes misalignment and collision bugs.
RMXP_Notes: Graphics/Tilesets: 32x32. Avoid sub-pixel placement; keep edges snapped.

Rule: Standard character frame: 32x48 per frame; charset sheet: 128x192 (4x4).
Rationale: Keeps character scale readable against 32x32 tiles and matches common RMXP charset conventions.
RMXP_Notes: Charset frames = sheet_width/4 by sheet_height/4. Larger sprites allowed only when justified (boss/NPC).

Rule: Default perspective: top-down with slight side view (RMXP style); keep consistent horizon/angles.
Rationale: Mixing perspectives makes maps feel incoherent and breaks depth cues.
RMXP_Notes: Tiles should share the same light direction and edge thickness.

Rule: Limit detail density: reserve high-contrast detail for interactables; keep background calmer.
Rationale: Guides player attention and improves readability during combat/quests.
RMXP_Notes: Prefer silhouette-first design for items and NPCs.

Rule: One global light direction for Act 1 (recommended: top-left).
Rationale: Consistency across tiles/characters reduces visual noise and supports quick recognition.
RMXP_Notes: Apply same shading logic to characters, props, UI icons.

Rule: Use a constrained palette per biome (Forest/Fae/Goblin Ruins/Mage Tower).
Rationale: Biome palettes help navigation and narrative tone without new UI.
RMXP_Notes: Keep 3-5 dominant hues + neutrals; avoid random saturation spikes.

Rule: Avoid pillow shading and banding; prefer 2–3 value steps + selective highlights.
Rationale: Cleaner pixel art with better volume perception at low resolution.
RMXP_Notes: Dither sparingly; use only to smooth large gradients (fog/skybox).

Rule: Autotiles: design seamless edges; test all transitions (inner/outer corners, cliffs, water).
Rationale: Autotiles will be recombined by RMXP; missing corner cases create visible seams.
RMXP_Notes: Graphics/Autotiles uses 96x128 template logic; always test in-engine.

Rule: Collision/passability: define a passability convention per tile type and document it in ART notes.
Rationale: Art must align with gameplay; visually 'walkable' tiles must not be blocked and vice-versa.
RMXP_Notes: Match tile visuals to passability flags in Tileset settings (X/O/★).

Rule: Props that block movement must show a clear base/footprint and depth shadow.
Rationale: Player must understand what blocks pathing from a glance.
RMXP_Notes: Use a 1–2px contact shadow at base.

Rule: Walk cycle readability over realism: emphasize limb swing and head bob within 4 frames.
Rationale: RMXP uses 4-pattern walking; subtle animation disappears at 32x48.
RMXP_Notes: Direction order (typical): Down, Left, Right, Up; verify in-engine.

Rule: Run variant uses same silhouette but stronger motion cues; keep frame size identical to walk.
Rationale: Allows speed change (SHIFT run) without animation glitches.
RMXP_Notes: Name convention: <base>_run.png; fallback to <base>.png when missing.

Rule: NPC readability rule: each major faction gets a distinctive palette accent + shape motif.
Rationale: Improves recognition for reputation/quest storytelling without extra text.
RMXP_Notes: Fae: soft glow accents; Goblins: jagged silhouettes; Rose village: warm cloth tones.

Rule: Icons: 24x24 or 32x32, centered; maintain 1px outline thickness policy.
Rationale: Consistent icons prevent UI jitter across windows and tooltips.
RMXP_Notes: RMXP icons often used in custom windows; keep even padding.

Rule: Windowskin: choose one base skin for Act 1; limit variants to states (danger/poison/quest).
Rationale: Too many UI skins look inconsistent and raise implementation cost.
RMXP_Notes: Default RMXP windowskin commonly 192x128; verify your base asset and keep it canonical.

Rule: Naming: use stable prefixes and semantic tokens; avoid spaces. Example: TIL_ACT1_FOREST_v01.png
Rationale: Supports deterministic packaging, checksums, and AI tooling.
RMXP_Notes: Recommended tokens: ACT#, BIOME, TYPE (TIL/CHR/ICON/UI), SUBJECT, v##

Rule: Never overwrite originals: increment v## and keep changelog notes per asset group.
Rationale: Prevents regressions and keeps binary diffs traceable in bundles.
RMXP_Notes: Bundle updates should record what changed and why.

Rule: Export: PNG, indexed or RGB; keep transparency clean (no semi-transparent halos).
Rationale: Halos show badly on RMXP backgrounds and break compositing.
RMXP_Notes: Prefer hard alpha edges or controlled 1px AA only when needed.

Rule: Act 1 pack must cover: Player (walk+run), 3 miniboss visuals, key biomes tileset(s), UI icons for quests/perícias.
Rationale: Ensures the local build is playable and readable for testing.
RMXP_Notes: Miniboss IDs: MB001/MB002/MB003 (see QA scope digest).

Rule: Act 1 pack SHOULD include: faction NPC variants, basic VFX (hit/spark), ambience props.
Rationale: Improves perceived quality without blocking functionality.

Rule: Start new RMXP art assets from the provided templates/overlays in ART_TEMPLATE_REGISTRY to avoid wrong dimensions and grid drift.
RMXP_Notes: Templates include tileset (256px wide, 32x32), charset (4x4 frames), windowskin (192x128), title (640x480), battleback (640x320), icons (24x24).
